releaseGating.reason: Synthetic baseline requires maintainer review before any release threshold is enabled.

limitations: The oracle uses a hand-authored four-node graph and a five-span trace; it is not representative of production workloads.
Expected classifications are fixture ground truth and do not estimate population-level precision or recall.
Explicit span bindings are supplied by the fixture, so binding discovery quality is outside this evaluation.
samplingCaveats: The sampled case removes the tail span from an otherwise identical trace and compares it with the complete-trace oracle.
Missing spans can become modeled-not-observed or observed-but-unmodeled; runtime-edge coverage reports retained parent/child edges only.
Coverage is a bounded sample ratio, not evidence that unobserved production edges do not exist.
